notes: Source: Eduvos Campus Admissions page.
Admission score type: Eduvos points. Life Orientation is granted 3 points from any percentage above 40%; other NSC subjects use the Eduvos 8-to-1 percentage band scale.
Programme source: https://www.eduvos.com/programmes/bachelor-of-commerce-in-law/.
Programme type: Degree.
SAQA ID: 120724.
Faculty: Law.
Available study modes: Distance Online Full Time, Distance Online Part Time, Campus Full Time, Online Part Time (PTAH), Online Full Time (FTAH).

Duration: Full-Time (Campus) Minimum: 3 years; Maximum: 5 yearsFull-Time (Online) Minimum: 3 years; Maximum: 5 yearsFull-Time (Distance) Minimum: 3 years; Maximum: 5 years | Part-Time (Online) Minimum: 5 years; Maximum: 7 yearsPart-Time (Distance) Minimum: 5 years; Maximum: 7 years.

Minimum admission requirements: South African National Senior Certificate (NSC) with Bachelor’s degree pass. Or National Certificate (Vocational) Level 4 issued by the Council of General and Further Education and Training with a Bachelor’s degree pass. Or letter or certificate confirming an exemption from Universities South Africa (USAf) for any other school-leaving results. Or completion of a Bachelor’s degree. Or completion of the relevant Foundation Programme along with a letter or certificate of exemption from Universities South Africa (USAf). Or completion of a relevant Higher Certificate. Or completion of the relevant Eduvos Access Programme.
Additional admission requirements from Eduvos Campus Admissions: 25 Eduvos points or more.
